description: Find the first closed-segment contact for each supplied directed query against supplied obstacles, retaining obstacle identity and explicit misses.

provenance.relationship: Independent contact dependency; source suffix-only two-pass web orchestration and incorrect extent checks are not inherited.

behavior.input: Exactly queries,obstacles,maxWork in a passive record. Validate keys; queries list and finite quadruples in order; obstacles list and finite quadruples in order; maxWork. Binary64 carriers only, no bool/string conversion. Java Byte,Short,Integer,Long,Float,Double only. Canonicalize signed zero. Validate all static input even when queries or obstacles empty. No defaults. Coordinates share caller units/origin/axes.
behavior.work: Let Q=queries.length,O=obstacles.length. Exact integer W=Q*O. WORK_LIMIT_EXCEEDED when W>maxWork after all static validation and before contact computation/output generation. W counts abstract pair tests, not arithmetic instructions, time or allocation. Counts are representational ceilings, not artistic ranges.
behavior.contact: Each query A+t(B-A) and obstacle C+u(D-C) is closed. Nonparallel intersection qualifies iff exact t,u in[0,1]. Parallel noncollinear pairs miss. Collinear pairs intersect in a closed query-parameter interval: choose its least t. A zero-length query has t=0 iff its point belongs to the obstacle; a point obstacle may be contacted. Empty intersection misses. No automatic self/same-origin filtering. All predicates and ordering use exact rational values of supplied binary64 inputs.
behavior.selection: Select smallest exact t per query, ties by smallest supplied obstacle ordinal. Obstacle orientation does not affect contact location. Query orientation does. Return one entry per query in original order: null for miss or record obstacleIndex,t,point. No mutation or feedback between queries; later obstacles are not shortened by earlier queries. Overlap extent is not returned.
behavior.rounding: After selecting contact round exact t and each exact A+t(B-A) coordinate once to binary64 nearest-even; normalize zero. Exact t=0/1 preserves corresponding normalized input endpoint. For exact0<t<1 throw REPRESENTATION_COLLAPSE stage parameter if rounded t is0or1; otherwise stage point if rounded point equals either query endpoint. Include queryIndex and stage. Check queries in input order; parameter before point. No partial output. Exact endpoint contacts including point queries are valid. Rounded point may lie slightly off exact obstacle; no painted-footprint guarantee.
behavior.ownership: Inputs not retained or mutated. Result owns contacts; exports detached data. No RNG,time,renderer or host objects. Native allocation failure remains host failure.
behavior.complexity: O(Q*O) exact geometric pair tests plus exact arithmetic bit costs; O(Q+O) captured input and O(Q) result storage; no per-pair retained result.
behavior.access: Java reference exposes static find(Object configuration), size(), hitAt(long index) and toValues(). hitAt returns null for miss or immutable Contact with obstacleIndex,t,x,y primitive fields. Negative indices produce INVALID_INDEX; index>=size produces INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE. toValues returns independently owned output-schema records/lists. No mutable array accessor is necessary for a single contact. Java ContactException extends IllegalArgumentException with public final code, queryIndex and stage; queryIndex=-1 and stage=null except representation collapse. Contact fields are immutable primitive values; constructors are private.

output_invariants: hits length equals query count. Each nonnull obstacleIndex is in supplied obstacle range; finite t in[0,1], finite point and canonical positive zero. Selection precedes rounding; no miss removal.

errors.REPRESENTATION_COLLAPSE: Interior selected contact cannot retain its distinction from a query endpoint; queryIndex and stage parameter or point.
errors.INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE: Nonnegative Java result index at or above size.

queries.evidence: Supplied directed strokes; plasma007 nearest-hit extraction and private web/connector study.

obstacles.evidence: Explicit obstacle substitution is project design; no source-specific ordering hidden.

maxWork.evidence: Engineering preflight, not an artistic recommendation.

reproduction.scope: Private precomputed exact-data views only; no Java implementation or full plasma007 reproduction.

review.status: Root reviewed closed-contact semantics and26 shared fixtures for Java implementation; no core/native support accepted.

exclusions: all intersection classification or overlap extent
